_source: DAMAC Properties website (project page 'Loreto at DAMAC Hills', read 18 September 2026); Dubai Municipality building record 431615 via the DLD parcel bridge (data/dld/dm_buildings_damachills.json).
_assets_from: DAMAC's own project page for Loreto: the hero photograph and the six-picture gallery (living, bedroom, bath, pool pergola, the blocks from the fairway, the clubhouse). Nothing was fetched from behind a form. The CDN serves the gallery at 434x326 pixels; fine on screen, soft in print.
completed_note: Dubai Municipality: completion certified 5 December 2016; permit 251231-3-2 of February 2015; G+7+1R, 30 m, two lifts. Sold furnished.
caveats: Loreto is six wings (1A to 3B) in nine low-rise blocks on one plot, registered as one Land Department project; the sales, rents and unit counts on this sheet are the register's figures across all six. The client's block is Loreto 3 - A.

The municipality holds one building record for the plot (G+7+1R, 30 m, certified 5 December 2016) and counts 84 flats in each of the six Loreto blocks - 504, the same count the Land Department's register carries.
